title: C20 precursor branches and their framework families.
C20 전구체 분기와 골격 계열.
intro: A compact overview of defined CPP, HPP and CLPP/KPP precursor families. Dotted connections classify their carbon frameworks. Open Full pathway for compatible class I products and downstream tailoring.
CPP·HPP·CLPP/KPP 전구체 계열을 간단히 살펴보는 지도입니다. 점선은 탄소 골격을 분류합니다. Full pathway에서 기질이 맞는 class I 산물과 후속 치환 단계를 확인하세요.

edges.label: (+)-CPS · TPS II
edges.detail: Produces (+)-CPP. Different CPP stereoisomers are separate substrates.

edges.label: ent-CPS · TPS II
edges.detail: Produces ent-CPP, a substrate for ent-kaurene synthases.

edges.label: syn-CPS · TPS II
edges.detail: Produces syn-CPP; rice OsCPS4 is a characterized example.

edges.label: HPS · TPS II
edges.detail: Produces halimadienyl/tuberculosinyl diphosphate. The HPP stereochemistry and double-bond positions must be stated.

edges.label: KPS · TPS II
edges.detail: Produces a specific KPP/CLPP stereoisomer. It does not stand for every cis/trans clerodane variant.

edges.label: Taxadiene synthase · TPS I
edges.detail: A direct GGPP-using class I cyclase. Not every diterpene pathway requires a class II step first.

edges.label: C20 clerodane backbone
edges.detail: A structural relationship, not an additional biochemical conversion.

edges.label: other CLPP configurations · TPS II
edges.detail: Alternative characterized class II products include cis-trans and cis-cis CLPP configurations. A specific downstream TPS pairing must be established for each precursor; the pictured KPP example is not universal.

edges.label: clerodane scaffold membership
edges.detail: Scaffold classification only. These are already C20 clerodane-related intermediates, not a universal pathway through the depicted (−)-KPP.

edges.label: Source relative class
edges.detail: The model retains a real diphosphate-bearing C20 connectivity while explicitly omitting unassigned absolute and side-chain configurations.

edges.label: Alternative substrate study
edges.detail: NNPP changes product stereochemistry in studied PvCPS1 systems; it does not identify a native Tinospora route.

edges.label: Precursor framework membership
edges.detail: A carbon-framework classification of the diphosphate precursor, not an additional enzyme step. Specific configurations remain attached to the individual precursor record.
